meta.write: residual tool: holes of R, then the Miller cut
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. Name the holes. A script that must move. Reading is not a bound.

lemmas.name: B37_residual_readable
lemmas.statement: three holes of R are readable on the n=32 caches: aligned P+, unaligned P+, off-E_c leftover
lemmas.why: Same caches as B15 / B16. No new FFT. No n=64. Named holes are not an integrable R.

lemmas.name: B37a_residual_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: naming the holes of R is a closed estimate for classical X
lemmas.why: A synthetic split is an apparatus. R is still the unknown. Sit down on leftover knobs.

lemmas.name: B37b_residual_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: readable holes make R integrable and therefore continue X
lemmas.why: Readability is not integrability. Hole 2 is the live cubic. Hole 1 is still an if. Hole 3 is not all-data Hardy.

lemmas.name: B37c_residual_not_ns
lemmas.statement: the synthetic R is an NS a priori
lemmas.why: A skeleton with blanks is not sitting the packet. Do not promote a reconstruction to a type.

lemmas.name: B37d_residual_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: the residual tool is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: Named holes are not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Beale still asks for the max.

lemmas.name: B37e_residual_not_regularity
lemmas.statement: the residual tool decides classical regularity
lemmas.why: No. Domain B stays open. The leftover is still a closed estimate for X. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B37f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: naming the holes of R is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The tool is a knob on the check. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B38_miller_readable
lemmas.statement: Miller λ2+ is a different cut from hole 2; hole 1(t) on the B15 cache stays a majority while visc eats X
lemmas.why: Same eigh as B15. No new FFT. No n=64. A different cut is not an integrable R.

lemmas.name: B38a_miller_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: the Miller cut is a closed estimate for classical X
lemmas.why: λ2+ is a different name for part of the cubic. Miller's identity is not an a priori. A strain model with the same identity blows.

lemmas.name: B38b_miller_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: a different cut plus hole 1(t) makes R integrable and therefore continues X
lemmas.why: A gap of 0.15 on this ensemble is not ∫‖λ2+‖_q < ∞. Hole 1(t) staying a majority is B15d in hole language.

lemmas.name: B38c_miller_not_ns
lemmas.statement: reading λ2+ on the working box is an NS a priori
lemmas.why: Keeping the middle eigenvalue of an already-computed eigh is a knob on the check. Sit down.

lemmas.name: B38d_miller_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: the Miller cut is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: λ2+ is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Beale still asks for the max.

lemmas.name: B38e_miller_not_regularity
lemmas.statement: the Miller cut decides classical regularity
lemmas.why: No. Domain B stays open. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B38f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: reading λ2+ is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. No Q1. No ε. Do not type c=8. Do not spawn n=64.

next_da_move: The residual tool names the holes in R. Miller λ2+ is a different cut from hole 2. Neither is an a priori. Hole 1 is the CF if. Hole 2 is the live cubic. Regularity leftover is not an a priori (B35e). Regularity stays open. Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
